slides.title: Screen observations for discussion
bullets: BP16-05472 and BP16-05482 show broad inhibition involving CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4.
BP16-05442 shows a different pattern, with CYP2D6 more prominent than CYP3A4.
BP16-05478 and BP16-05512 show little inhibition across the displayed panel.
These observations support discussion, not a final progression recommendation.
slides.notes: No named article is assumed to be the unresolved vial. Identity mapping: [TBC].
